svg.title: Object detection and localization · animated neural network forward pass
svg.desc: An animated feedforward neural network with an input image demo whose candidate region is cropped into five region features, two shared layers of six neurons each, a classification head with three classes, an objectness head, and a bounding box regression head. The outputs merge into candidate detections followed by thresholding and nonmaximum suppression. The drawing is illustrative, not a literal trained model.
